newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU vets Archer Daniels buy of cocoa unit.
newsitem.headline: EU vets Archer Daniels buy of cocoa unit.

text.p: The European Commission said on Tuesday it was vetting the proposed acquisition of the cocoa business of W.R. Grace & Company by Archer Daniels Midland Co, both based in the United States.
It said the deal was submitted for clearance on January 20 under the European Union's merger rules which ban creation or strengthening of dominant positions.
The Commission has a month from that date to clear the operation or start a full probe if it is worried about the impact on fair competition in Europe.

The sale of Grace Cocoa Associates was concluded in December for $430 million. The company, which produces and sells industrial cocoa and chocolate products, has operations in Europe, North and South America, Africa and Asia Pacific.
The deal will give Archer Daniels Midland, which is active in procuring and processing agricultural commodities, its first entry into the industrial cocoa and chocolate business.
